prompt: The objective of this problem is to calculate the total number of occurrences of a specific word in the text files inside a given directory. You will need to navigate through the Linux operating system, use shell commands and produce a single integer as output. Ensure you navigate to the correct directory as specified below. Here is the detailed question description: 1. You are given a directory named "assignment" located in your home directory (`~/assignment/`). 2. Inside the "assignment" directory, there are multiple files - both text files (with `.txt` extension) and non-text files. 3. Your task is to find the total number of occurrences of the word "Linux" (case insensitive) in all the text files within this directory.
